Two formula errors in the arc cosine / arc tangent definitions. (1) The third arccos formula is 2 log(sqrt((1+z)/2) + i sqrt((1-z)/2))/i in the TeX; the EPUB has i (sqrt(1-z)/2), moving the sqrt off the whole quotient. (2) The arctan definition is (log(1+iz) - log(1-iz))/(2i); the EPUB drops the parentheses and reads log (1+iz) - log (1-iz) /2i, which is a different expression.
